claims: Caleb Foster is a Duke guard.
Caleb Foster sustained a fractured right foot against North Carolina.
Caleb Foster fractured his right foot during the first half of the March 7, 2026 game against UNC.
Caleb Foster underwent surgery on March 8, 2026 to repair a fractured right foot.
Caleb Foster's surgery was performed on Sunday morning, March 8, 2026.
Caleb Foster returned to play on March 27, 2026.
Caleb Foster's return to play was 19-20 days after surgery.
Caleb Foster's return game was against St. John's in the NCAA Tournament.
Caleb Foster played 19 minutes in the NCAA Sweet 16.
Caleb Foster scored 11 points in his return game.
Caleb Foster scored all 11 points in the second half of his return game.
Caleb Foster had 3 rebounds in his return game.
Caleb Foster had 2 assists in his return game.
Duke won Caleb Foster's return game 80-75.
Head coach Jon Scheyer described Caleb Foster's return as incredible and a display of leadership
